elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 caps liability at the greater of fees paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect or consequential damages, subject to Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party’s breach of confidentiality obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breaches of data-protection or security obligations in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes a Party’s indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes gross negligence in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.
Section 21.3 includes fraud in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property in Excluded Claims, which are excluded from the cap.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that Customer’s payment obligations are not damages and are not limited by Section 21.
